vb_textbox.text: I feel that the of the two gnomes presented, the one with the taller hat was the more profitable, but correlating to his color. Brown was profitable, purple was not. Of the two forests I managed to score high mushrooms in each one so I believe the pattern lies in the gnomes and their colours and isnt to do with the forests. Another observation I had was that if you get a low streak then ignore purple tall gnome = bad and try him out, the numbers seem to fluctuate a lot and there may not even be a pattern. Good luck to you ! :)
